prompt: If the homeowner were willing to leave part of the mark visible, what would still prevent the Reed from being used without drilling?
promptZh: 假如住戶願意讓一小段痕跡外露，仍有什麼原因使 Reed 無法在不鑽孔的情況下安裝？

options.text: The cover could not reach the right edge.
options.whyZh: 即使允許外露，現有孔仍無法對準。

options.text: It is not made in the original finish.
options.zh: 沒有原本的表面處理款式。
options.whyZh: 三款都提供原本的表面處理。

options.text: Its screws would not line up with the existing holes.
options.zh: 它的螺絲對不上現有孔位。
options.whyZh: 128 公釐孔距與現有 96 公釐不同。

options.text: The locally installed front cannot take any replacement pull.
options.zh: 本地更換的面板不能裝任何替換把手。
options.whyZh: 並非任何款式都不行，只要選正確孔距即可。

explanationZh: 128 公釐孔距與現有 96 公釐不同。
evidence: The hole centers are 96 mm apart. | Reed: 128 mm between screw centers | A replacement must fit the existing holes.

vocabulary.note: 此處指把手能安裝在已存在的孔位。

difficultyRationale: 反事實移除外觀限制，留下孔距限制。
